cohort: Pregnant women who had serum bile acid (SBA) tests requested by the Obstetrics and Gynaecology Department at University Malaya Medical Center from January 1, 2016, to December 31, 2020.
finding: The prevalence of ICP was 0.18%, average gestation at diagnosis was 35 weeks, and early diagnosis and timely delivery are important to reduce perinatal adverse outcomes.
mod_finding: Women with severe ICP (SBA >40 µmol/L) all had cesarean sections, while only 44% of those with mild ICP (SBA 10-40µmol/L) had cesarean sections.
gest_age: Average gestation at diagnosis was 35 weeks.
